background_story: Colson was a brilliant software engineer with a passion for innovative design. Growing up, he spent countless hours coding and experimenting with new technologies. His fascination with the humble cursor led him to develop a revolutionary new interface that changed the way people interacted with computers. Colson's design, dubbed 'CursorFlow,' used AI to predict and adapt to the user's movements, making navigation faster and more intuitive. The breakthrough earned him widespread recognition in the tech community, and his company, CursorTech, became a leader in the field. Colson's obsession with the cursor had unlocked a new era of human-computer interaction, and his name became synonymous with innovation and forward thinking.
